description: Get an actor's details: description, system prompt, capabilities, and status. list_actor_knowledge has the knowledge it carries into runs.
name: get_actor

capabilities.description: Capability settings as a JSON object: model, temperature, maxTokens, emailUsername (the inbox address, assigned when the actor is created and never changed), and switches such as useBrowser, receiveEmail, webSearch and memory. receiveSms is on while the actor holds a phone number for text message codes (Startup and above); numbers are given to an actor in the dashboard, not by this tool, so setting receiveSms here does not give it one.

description.description: Who the persona is: background, goals, tech comfort.

is_starter.description: True for the starter actors a new workspace is seeded with.

kind.description: "persona" plays a person using the product in a browser. "agent" plays an AI agent acting for someone: on checklist runs it also reads the site's agent files (robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP manifests), calls the site's API and the MCP servers attached to the project or actor, and reports the gaps it hits, which show as agent evidence on the run report.

location.description: Optional location the persona browses from, as JSON, or null.

status.description: Lifecycle state: "active" actors can run; "archived" ones are soft-deleted.

system_prompt.description: Extra instructions layered on the persona, or null when none are set.

worker_id.description: Self-hosted worker UUID it is pinned to, if any.

worker_mode.description: Where its browser runs: "cloud" (hosted), "pinned" (the self-hosted worker in worker_id) or "pool" (any self-hosted worker).

title: Get actor
